item.description:
Fixes

  • A release card now clears by itself once the tool is updated, from its Update button or your own terminal: it shows "Updated" for a moment, then goes. Cards for tools updated while Visor was closed clear at launch.
  • Tools installed from a Homebrew tap other than Homebrew core no longer get an update card they can't use.

New

  • Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and OpenCode sessions show in the Agents tab next to Claude Code, Copilot CLI and Antigravity, read from their own files with no setup.
  • Release radar: a short peek when a tool you use ships a new version, and a "What's new" card in Usage with its top changes until you dismiss it. Checked every 6 hours.
  • Update on a release card runs that tool's own update command in a new Terminal window.
  • MCP health: one line under your sessions says how many MCP servers your agents use and which one is failing ("figma failed 3x in web-shop"). Click it for every server, what calls it and its most-used tools.
  • Builds you make yourself show an orange line under the notch and an orange menu bar icon, so you can tell them from the release.
